title: TextHumanize input
description: Enter the text (or a batch of texts) to process and pick a mode. Results are stored in the default dataset, and a run summary is saved to the key-value store under the SUMMARY key. Humanization options are ignored in 'Detect' and 'Analyze' modes.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: **Humanize** rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads more naturally, **Detect** estimates how AI-like a text is, and **Analyze** returns style and artificiality metrics.
enumTitles: Humanize — rewrite text to sound human

text.title: Text
text.description: Single text to process. Ignored when the batch field below is filled.
text.prefill: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, businesses must leverage comprehensive strategies to unlock their full potential. It is important to note that effective communication serves as a cornerstone of success, facilitating collaboration and driving innovation across teams. Furthermore, organizations that prioritize adaptability are well-positioned to navigate challenges and seize emerging opportunities in an ever-evolving marketplace.

texts.title: Texts (batch)
texts.description: Optional list of texts processed in a single run. When filled, the 'Text' field is ignored and each item is processed separately.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the input text, or 'Detect automatically' to let the Actor identify it. 25 languages have dedicated dictionaries; other ISO codes fall back to the universal processor.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Style profile that guides the rewrite. 'Web' is a good default for articles and blog posts; 'SEO' is the most conservative.

targetStyle.title: Target style (optional)
targetStyle.description: Optional author style to imitate: student, copywriter, scientist, journalist, blogger, editor, founder, expert or support.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: How aggressively the text is rewritten: 0 leaves the text untouched, 100 is the maximum. Around 60 is a good balance for most texts.

qualityGate.title: Quality gate
qualityGate.description: With 'Strict', the Actor reverts changes when they would reduce similarity, grammar score or readability.

minimal.title: Minimal changes
minimal.description: Only rewrite sentences flagged as AI-like and leave everything else untouched.

phantom.title: PHANTOM™ post-processing
phantom.description: Run the PHANTOM™ neural optimization pass to push AI-detection scores lower. Slower, but stronger.

includeDetection.title: Include AI detection
includeDetection.description: Compute AI-detection probability before and after humanization (adds processing time). Only used in 'Humanize' mode.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible output. In batch mode each text uses seed + its position.

keepKeywords.title: Keep keywords
keepKeywords.description: SEO keywords that must be preserved in the rewritten text.

protectTerms.title: Protect terms
protectTerms.description: Brand names, product names and other terms that must never be modified.

concurrency.title: Batch concurrency
concurrency.description: How many texts to process in parallel in batch mode (1-8). Higher values improve throughput on large batches.
